EC1: clinically significant medical [OR] or neurologic condition [OR] or neurocognitive dysfunction that would affect function and/or task performance and/or interfere with the study protocol
EC2: any current (or within past 2 months) medical condition [AND] requiring medication that would interact with dronabinol [OR] or interfere with the study protocol
EC3: risk of harm to self or others that requires immediate intervention
EC4: presence of contraindications [OR], current [OR] or past allergic or adverse reaction [OR], or known sensitivity [AND] to cannabinoid-like substances (dronabinol [OR]/marijuana [OR]/cannabis [OR]/THC [OR], cannabinoid oil [OR], sesame oil [OR], gelatin [OR], glycerin [OR], and titanium dioxide)
EC6: positive drug screen [OR] or alcohol breathalyzer
EC7: unwilling/unable to sign informed consent document
EC8: currently pregnant  (positive pregnancy test) [OR], planning pregnancy [OR], or lactating (women)
EC9: under 18 or over 50 years of age
EC10: traumatic brain injury (as defined by The American Congress of Rehabilitation as a person who has had a traumatically induced physiological disruption of brain function (i.e., the head being struck, the head striking an object, and/or the brain undergoing an acceleration/deceleration movement (i.e., whiplash) without direct external trauma to the head), as manifested by at least one of the following: any loss of consciousness; any loss of memory for events immediately before or after the injury; any alteration in mental status at the time of the incident; or focal neurological deficits that may or may not be transient)
EC11: [NOT] inability to tolerate small, enclosed spaces without anxiety [AND] (e.g. claustrophobia), as determined by self-report and/or a preliminary session in a mock scanner
EC13: presence of ferrous-containing metals within the body (e.g., aneurysm clips [OR], shrapnel [OR]/retained particles)
EC14: anticipation of a required drug test in the 4 weeks following the study.
EC15: current diagnosis of a mood [OR], anxiety [OR], or other disorder that is more clinically salient than PTSD
EC16: current moderate [OR] or severe alcohol [OR]/drug use disorder or in the past 8 weeks
EC17: current or past diagnosis of bipolar [OR] and other related disorders [OR], schizophrenia spectrum [OR], or other psychotic disorders
EC18: concomitant treatments [AND] with medication [AND] known to have drug interactions [AND] with dronabinol, such as, central nervous system depressants [OR] (barbiturates [OR], benzodiazepines [OR], buspirone [OR], lithium, etc) and anticholinergic agents (atropine [OR], scopolamine [OR], antihistamines, etc).
